name: Blink (3-state)
description: Open → half → closed → half → open on a natural cadence (fast close, brief hold, slightly slower open, ~2.6s open between blinks). Crossfades blend the three drawings.

slots.label: Open
slots.instruction: Eyes/face fully open — the neutral idle pose.

slots.label: Half-open
slots.instruction: Eyelids roughly halfway — the in-between pose.
